biggest_catch: The reward is 35 gallons of fuel priced at Suburban Propane's own per-gallon rate, so its cash value moves with propane prices (ranges $1.64-$4.71 by state); the account credit cannot be refunded in cash.
catches: Only available to existing Suburban Propane customers.
The referred person must be accepted as a new Residential Fuel Delivery Customer and receive their first fuel delivery before credit is issued.
Only one credit is issued for each new customer; no cash refunds if the credit is not fully used.

steps: As an existing Suburban Propane customer, submit a referral via the online form or call 1-800-PROPANE (mention code 2618).
Your friend or family member becomes a new Residential Fuel Delivery Customer.
After they receive their first fuel delivery, 35 free gallons are credited to your account.
The gallons offset your future propane deliveries; no cash payout.
